registration: Footprints read in the site frame from Google's map building outlines (zoom 21, inspected 2026-10-23), aligned to the NatWest London Street line. OSM way 371741580 wrongly folds the mock-Tudor building into NatWest and way 371741581 merges the rest into one block; neither is used for these divisions. Edges are about +/-0.5m.
heights: Working estimates from August 2024 Street View, checked against 2019 panorama: William Hill low two-storey frontage; KBA two gabled bays; opticians brick parapet and pitched dormered roof. Heights are not surveyed.

blocks.name: 11-13 William Hill
blocks.evidence: Google ground-plan outline gives approximately 8.95 m overall building frontage. The 2016 auction quotes 7.9248 m gross shop frontage and 20.3962 m built depth, vendor supplied; these do not securely establish the entire building boundary. Retain map division. Close 3D orbit shows a sloping front roof and taller pitched rear range.
blocks.height_definition: Maximum roof height above asset ground datum; estimated

blocks.name: 15-17 KBA
blocks.evidence: August 2024 Street View: two projecting canted bays with decorative timber gables, pale render, lower rear extensions; no single central gable.
